summary: The stored positive is a single-blind trial of the total triterpenic fraction (TTFCA, 60 and 120 mg) in venous disease. No label here prints TTFCA. Labels print herb powder, whole herb extract (some 10:1), leaf or aerial extract, and two print a triterpene percentage (306227 10%, 219195 6% glycosides). The cognition meta-analysis found no differences across domains (28878245), and the labeled cognitive use isn't supported. Extract trials are small or on other purposes.

stop_or_hold: No herb powder efficacy trial turned up in 3 searches apart from the single 12 g dose in 11106141, whose abstract doesn't name a form. 8 labels print powder or plain herb rows (18388, 216378, 63950, 63961, 251608, 251610, 327976, 333920), so no trial read covers them at label amounts. If a clinician ever credits an extract, these need excluding.
